general_skills.title: Systematic Exploration
general_skills.principle: Search every plausible surface or container exactly once before revisiting; prioritize unopened or unseen locations to cover the whole room methodically.
general_skills.when_to_apply: Anytime the goal object count is not yet met and unexplored locations remain.

general_skills.title: Immediate Acquisition
general_skills.principle: As soon as a required object becomes visible and reachable, take it before moving elsewhere to avoid losing track or re-searching.
general_skills.when_to_apply: Upon first visual confirmation of a goal-relevant object.

general_skills.title: Destination First Policy
general_skills.principle: After picking up a goal object, navigate directly to the known target receptacle and place it before resuming further search.
general_skills.when_to_apply: Holding any goal object while its target location has been identified.

general_skills.title: Track Counts & Progress
general_skills.principle: Maintain an internal counter of how many goal objects are still needed; stop searching or terminate episode only when the counter reaches zero.
general_skills.when_to_apply: Throughout multi-instance tasks (e.g., “put two X…”).

general_skills.title: Use State-Changing Tools Early
general_skills.principle: For tasks requiring heated/cooled/clean objects, acquire the object, then immediately use the nearest suitable appliance to change its state before any placement.
general_skills.when_to_apply: After picking up an object that must change temperature or cleanliness.

general_skills.title: Establish Spatial Relations
general_skills.principle: When a goal specifies a relation (under/inside/on), first locate the reference object, adjust its state if needed (e.g., turn lamp on), then search the specified spatial region for the target object or place it there.
general_skills.when_to_apply: Tasks containing spatial prepositions like under, inside, on, in_front_of.

general_skills.title: Open Before Judging Empty
general_skills.principle: Treat any closed container as unexplored; open it and inspect contents before deciding that the goal object is absent.
general_skills.when_to_apply: Encountering a closed drawer, cabinet, fridge, microwave, etc.

general_skills.title: Avoid Redundant Rechecks
general_skills.principle: Record which locations and containers have been fully inspected; do not revisit them unless new evidence suggests their contents changed.
general_skills.when_to_apply: After the first full pass of a location or when considering next search target.

general_skills.title: Plan with Landmarks
general_skills.principle: Continuously update and reference a map of known object and container locations to choose shortest paths and prevent aimless wandering.
general_skills.when_to_apply: Each time a new furniture piece, container, or goal object is observed.

general_skills.title: Progressive Goal Decomposition
general_skills.principle: Break tasks into ordered sub-goals: (1) locate object, (2) obtain or transform it, (3) locate destination/reference object, (4) satisfy spatial relation/placement, completing each sub-goal before moving to the next.
general_skills.when_to_apply: At the start of every episode and whenever the environment state invalidates the current sub-goal.

general_skills.title: Efficient Relation Search
general_skills.principle: When the goal pairs two objects (A under/on/inside B), restrict search for A to locations near B and vice-versa, instead of treating them independently.
general_skills.when_to_apply: On goals that mention both a target object and a reference object.

general_skills.title: Terminate Only On Success
general_skills.principle: Issue the 'done' action exclusively after validating that all goal conditions are met; otherwise continue searching or correcting object states.
general_skills.when_to_apply: Before ending an episode or when the agent believes the task is complete.

general_skills.title: Station Action Execution
general_skills.principle: When at the required transformation station and holding the object, perform the action immediately.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When at a sinkbasin, fridge, microwave, etc. with appropriate object.

general_skills.title: Common Sense Object Location
general_skills.principle: Begin search at the furniture type where the object is normally stored (e.g., soapbar on shelf, spoon in drawer).
general_skills.when_to_apply: When starting a task that requires finding a specific household object.

general_skills.title: Examine Open Surfaces First
general_skills.principle: Before opening closed containers, examine all open surfaces (countertops, tables, shelves) for the target object.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When searching for an object and open surfaces are nearby.

general_skills.title: Direct Transformation Then Placement
general_skills.principle: After cleaning, heating, or cooling the object, go immediately to the target location and place it without wandering.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you have just transformed the object and the destination is known.

general_skills.title: Sequential Container Opening
general_skills.principle: Open containers in increasing numerical order without skipping to ensure systematic search.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When searching for a target object and multiple closed containers exist.

general_skills.title: Transform Immediately After Pickup
general_skills.principle: After picking up an object that requires cleaning, cooling, or heating, go directly to the appropriate station and perform the transformation.
general_skills.when_to_apply: After picking up an object that needs transformation before placement.

general_skills.title: No Examine on Held Object
general_skills.principle: Do not examine or look at an object you are holding; instead proceed to the next required action.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When holding an object that needs to be transformed or placed.

general_skills.title: Open Destination Before Placement
general_skills.principle: Before placing an object into a container, ensure the container is open.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When about to place an object into a closed container.

general_skills.title: Hold Object Through Transformation
general_skills.principle: Once you pick up the target object, do not drop it until after the required transformation and final placement.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When holding an object that needs cleaning, cooling, or heating.

general_skills.title: Search Containers Before Surfaces
general_skills.principle: First open all closed containers systematically, then check open surfaces (countertops, tables, etc.) for the target.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When the target object is not immediately visible and the task requires locating it.

general_skills.title: Switch Search Domain After Empties
general_skills.principle: After opening two empty containers of the same type, move to a different location type, e.g., from cabinets to countertops.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When searching for a target object and encountering consecutive empty containers.

general_skills.title: Cover All Container Types Once
general_skills.principle: Before revisiting any container type, check at least one of each other type: cabinets, drawers, shelves, fridge.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When the target is not found after initial searches and multiple container types exist.

general_skills.title: Proceed Directly After Acquisition
general_skills.principle: Once you hold the target object, immediately go to the next required location without extra exploration.
general_skills.when_to_apply: After picking up the object needed for the task.

general_skills.title: Surface Check Before Open
general_skills.principle: Move to each container to check its top before opening it.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When searching for an object and closed containers are present.

general_skills.title: Switch Type After Two Empties
general_skills.principle: After opening two containers of the same type and finding nothing, switch to a different container type.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When two consecutive same-type containers are empty.

general_skills.title: Exhaust Open Surfaces First
general_skills.principle: Search all open surfaces like countertops and cabinet tops before opening any closed container.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you enter a room and need to locate an object.

general_skills.title: Cease Search on Target
general_skills.principle: When the target object is inside an open container, take it immediately and stop all further exploration.
general_skills.when_to_apply: After opening a container and seeing the goal object inside.

general_skills.title: Scan All Open Surfaces
general_skills.principle: At the start, read the initial room description and visit every open surface listed there to check for the target.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When the target object is not directly visible upon entering the room.

general_skills.title: Switch After Two Misses
general_skills.principle: If you open two containers of the same type and neither holds the target, switch to a different container type.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When two consecutive containers of one type are opened without finding the goal object.

general_skills.title: Three Empties Switch
general_skills.principle: After opening three containers of the same type and finding them empty, switch to a different location type like open surfaces or drawers.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When three consecutive identical container opens yield nothing.

general_skills.title: Open Before Moving
general_skills.principle: When you arrive at a closed container, open it immediately before moving to any other container.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When exploring containers to find a target object.

general_skills.title: Categorical Target Grab
general_skills.principle: If the seen object belongs to the same category as the target (e.g., any knife for 'knife'), take it immediately.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When an object is visible and its type matches the target category.

general_skills.title: Switch After Non-Target Find
general_skills.principle: After opening a container that contains a non-target object, switch to a different container type immediately.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you open a container and see an object that is not the target.

general_skills.title: Begin at Countertop
general_skills.principle: Always start your search by going to a countertop, as target objects are frequently found on open surfaces.
general_skills.when_to_apply: At the start of any task when the target object's location is unknown.

general_skills.title: Sequential Container Search
general_skills.principle: After the countertop, systematically open each container in order without skipping any.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When the target is not on open surfaces and containers are present.

general_skills.title: Exhaust All Furniture
general_skills.principle: If the target is still missing after checking all containers, examine other furniture like sinks, bathtubs, and shelves.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When containers have been exhausted and target not found.

general_skills.title: Open Upon Arrival
general_skills.principle: When you arrive at a closed container, open it before moving to another location.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you reach a closed cabinet, drawer, or fridge.

general_skills.title: Avoid Premature Pickup
general_skills.principle: Do not take an object unless you have a plan to transform and place it immediately.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When an object matching the target type is seen.

general_skills.title: Start at Countertop
general_skills.principle: Begin your search by going to the countertop, as it is the most common open surface with target objects.
general_skills.when_to_apply: At the start of a task before exploring containers.

general_skills.title: Avoid Re-Opening Containers
general_skills.principle: If you have already opened a container and seen its contents, do not open it again. Move on to the next.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you encounter a previously opened container.

general_skills.title: No Detours After Pickup
general_skills.principle: After picking up the target object, do not wander; go straight to the transformation appliance or destination.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you have just picked up an object that needs cleaning, cooling, or heating.

general_skills.title: Open Then Take
general_skills.principle: Always open a container before trying to take an object from it.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you need to retrieve an object from a closed container.

general_skills.title: Close Empty Containers
general_skills.principle: After finding no target in an open container, close it to avoid confusion.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When a container is open and empty.

general_skills.title: Same-Type Exhaustion
general_skills.principle: Search all containers of the same type before switching to a different type.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you have started searching a particular container type.

general_skills.title: Examine Open Surfaces Only
general_skills.principle: Do not use examine on closed containers; use open to reveal contents. Examine only on open surfaces.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you need to check a container's contents.

general_skills.title: Begin Search on Countertops
general_skills.principle: Start your search on countertops and other open surfaces before opening containers.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When starting a new task and objects may be on surfaces.

general_skills.title: Exhaust Cabinets Before Drawers
general_skills.principle: Open all cabinets of the same type before switching to drawers or other containers.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When searching for an object and cabinets remain unopened.

general_skills.title: Open Before Examine
general_skills.principle: Always use open on a closed container to see its contents instead of examine.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When facing a closed container that may hold the target object.

general_skills.title: Switch Type After One Empty
general_skills.principle: If a container is empty, switch to a different type of container immediately rather than opening another of the same type.
general_skills.when_to_apply: After opening a container and finding it empty.

general_skills.title: Take Seen Target Without Delay
general_skills.principle: When you open a container and see the target object, pick it up immediately without further search.
general_skills.when_to_apply: After opening a container and the target is visible inside.

general_skills.title: Exact Name Match
general_skills.principle: Only pick up an object if its displayed name exactly matches the target object in the task description.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you see an object that might be the target.

general_skills.title: Return to Start After Search
general_skills.principle: If you have searched multiple locations without finding the target, return to your starting surface and re-examine it.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you have exhausted several areas and still lack the target.

general_skills.title: Resume Search After Placement
general_skills.principle: After placing an object, check if the task requires more of the same object; if so, resume searching for the next one.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you have just placed an object in a multi-object task.

general_skills.title: All Open Surfaces Before Containers
general_skills.principle: Before opening any closed container, inspect all open surfaces like countertops and tables for the target object.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When the target object is not immediately visible and open surfaces remain.

general_skills.title: Open Destination Before Placing
general_skills.principle: If the destination is a closed container, open it before attempting to place the object inside.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When placing an object into a closed drawer, cabinet, or similar container.

general_skills.title: Prioritize Task-Relevant Furniture
general_skills.principle: Only visit furniture likely to contain the target or required for the task; avoid irrelevant ones like towel holders unless the target is a cloth.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When starting a new task and deciding where to go first.

general_skills.title: Take Target After Container Open
general_skills.principle: Once a container is opened and contains the target, take it immediately without any intervening examine or other actions.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you have just opened a container and see the target object inside.

general_skills.title: Avoid Early Sink Visits
general_skills.principle: Do not go to a sinkbasin or other appliance before you have picked up the object that needs cleaning or transformation.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When the task requires cleaning or transformation and you have not yet acquired the object.

general_skills.title: Grab on First Encounter
general_skills.principle: When you see the target object on an open surface, take it immediately before moving to any other location.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When the target object is visible on an open surface and you are not already holding it.

general_skills.title: One Empty Container Rule
general_skills.principle: If a container is opened and empty, do not open another of same type; check open surfaces or different types first.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you open a container and find no target object inside.

general_skills.title: Scan All Items on Arrival
general_skills.principle: Upon reaching a new location, read the list of visible objects to identify the target before deciding next action.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you move to any new surface or furniture.

general_skills.title: Direct to Transformation
general_skills.principle: After picking up the target, go straight to the transformation appliance without detours or intermediate actions.
general_skills.when_to_apply: Immediately after acquiring the target object for cleaning, cooling, or heating.

general_skills.title: No Intermediate Placement
general_skills.principle: Do not set down the target object on any surface except the transformation appliance or final destination.
general_skills.when_to_apply: While holding the target object before it is transformed or placed.

general_skills.title: Pick Visible Target First
general_skills.principle: If the target object is visible on an open surface, take it immediately without opening containers.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When searching for a known object and it appears in the observation.

general_skills.title: Open Only If Needed
general_skills.principle: Do not open closed containers unless the target object is not visible on any open surface.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When the target is not yet found and open surfaces have been checked.

general_skills.title: Sequential Open Surface Scan
general_skills.principle: When searching, visit all open surfaces (countertops, tables) in numerical order before opening any containers.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible and multiple open surfaces exist.

general_skills.title: Avoid Transformation Site Without Object
general_skills.principle: Never go to sinkbasin, fridge, microwave, or stoveburner unless holding an object that needs that transformation.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When exploring for a target object to manipulate.

general_skills.title: Avoid Redundant Information Actions
general_skills.principle: Do not use 'look' or 'inventory' actions during task; they waste steps and reveal no new object locations.
general_skills.when_to_apply: Anytime during object search or manipulation.

general_skills.title: Monotonic Surface Sweep
general_skills.principle: Visit open surfaces in a fixed order (e.g., countertop1..N, then diningtable) without backtracking until all checked.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When searching for a target object on open surfaces.

general_skills.title: Immediate Grab on Sight
general_skills.principle: If the target object is seen on an open surface, take it immediately before exploring further.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When the target object is visible and not yet held.

general_skills.title: Scan Adjacent Countertops First
general_skills.principle: When the target is not found, check nearby countertops before moving to other furniture types.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When searching for an object and the current surface lacks it.

general_skills.title: Return to Safe Start After Fail
general_skills.principle: If multiple containers yield no target, return to a known open surface like countertop to reorient.
general_skills.when_to_apply: After opening several containers without finding the target.

general_skills.title: Start at Countertop One
general_skills.principle: Begin every task by navigating to countertop 1 to initiate a systematic search of open surfaces.
general_skills.when_to_apply: At the start of a new task when location of target is unknown.

general_skills.title: Immediate Transformation After Pickup
general_skills.principle: After picking up the target object, go directly to the appropriate transformation appliance and use it.
general_skills.when_to_apply: Immediately after acquiring the target object, before any other actions.

general_skills.title: Direct Placement After Transformation
general_skills.principle: After transforming the object, go directly to the destination and place it without any detours.
general_skills.when_to_apply: After completing the transformation step and before any other exploration.

general_skills.title: Initial Look Action
general_skills.principle: Always start a new task by using the look action to observe the entire room.
general_skills.when_to_apply: Immediately after the task description is given.

general_skills.title: Limit Container Openings
general_skills.principle: Search open surfaces thoroughly before opening any containers; if not found, open containers one by one without backtracking.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When the target object is not immediately visible.

general_skills.title: Check Destination Surface First
general_skills.principle: When the goal object may be on the destination surface, examine that surface before searching containers.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When the destination is an open surface like a sofa or countertop.

general_skills.title: Finish One Furniture Type
general_skills.principle: When searching for a target, examine all containers of one type (e.g., all cabinets) before switching to another type.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When the target is not found on open surfaces.

general_skills.title: Sequential Surface Sweep
general_skills.principle: Search all open surfaces of the same type (e.g., dining tables) consecutively before moving to a different furniture type.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When searching for a target object on open surfaces and the first surface of a type is empty.

general_skills.title: Avoid Premature Container Opening
general_skills.principle: Do not open containers until all open surfaces in the current area have been examined.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When target object is not immediately visible on arrival.

general_skills.title: After Toggle, Stay and Examine
general_skills.principle: After using a tool or appliance, do not leave the area; examine the immediate vicinity for the target.
general_skills.when_to_apply: After performing a state-changing action on a tool like a lamp or microwave.

general_skills.title: After Clean Go Directly
general_skills.principle: After cleaning the object, go straight to the destination without visiting other locations.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you have cleaned an object and need to place it.

general_skills.title: Hold Object to Sink
general_skills.principle: If you are holding the target and need to clean it, go directly to the sink without dropping it.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you have picked up an object that requires cleaning.

general_skills.title: Three Empties Switch
general_skills.principle: After opening three containers of the same type without finding the target, switch to a different container type.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When searching for an object and containers yield nothing.

general_skills.title: No Detour After Pickup
general_skills.principle: After picking up the target object, go directly to the transformation location without any intermediate actions.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When holding an object that needs cleaning, heating, or cooling.

general_skills.title: Skip Empty Returns
general_skills.principle: After placing one object, if the previous location is empty, move to the next open surface in the initial scan order.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When searching for additional objects after placing the first.

general_skills.title: Countertop First Then Containers
general_skills.principle: Search all countertops thoroughly before opening any cabinets or drawers.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When the target object is not immediately visible on open surfaces.

general_skills.title: Acquire Before Transformation
general_skills.principle: Always pick up the object before moving to any transformation site such as sink or fridge.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When the target object is visible and the next step requires cleaning or cooling.

general_skills.title: Open Specific Destination
general_skills.principle: When placing a held object into a container, open only that exact destination container before moving.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you have an object to place and the destination is a closed container.

general_skills.title: Return to Source for Multiples
general_skills.principle: After placing one of multiple required objects, go back to the location where you found it to search for the remaining ones.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you have placed one object and more of the same type are still needed.

general_skills.title: Avoid Closed Container Examination
general_skills.principle: Never examine a closed drawer or cabinet; open it first to see its contents.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you encounter a closed container and want to know what is inside.

general_skills.title: Take Matching Category Objects
general_skills.principle: If the task specifies a generic type (e.g., 'some box'), accept any object of that category.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When the target description is vague and you see a similar object.

general_skills.title: Countertop Sequential Scan
general_skills.principle: When starting a task, systematically visit all countertops in numerical order before any other furniture.
general_skills.when_to_apply: At the beginning of a task where object location unknown.

general_skills.title: Avoid Premature Drawer Opening
general_skills.principle: Do not open drawers or cabinets until you have visited all countertops and open tables.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When countertops remain unchecked and drawers are present.

general_skills.title: Exhaust Countertop Pair
general_skills.principle: Always check both countertop 1 and countertop 2 before moving to other furniture.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When beginning search on countertop 1 and target not visible.

general_skills.title: Diningtable Before Appliances
general_skills.principle: After countertops, search diningtable before checking stoveburners, fridge, or sink.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When countertops are empty and target not found.

general_skills.title: Avoid Premature Sink Visit
general_skills.principle: Do not go to sink unless you are holding the target object to be cleaned.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you have not yet acquired the target object.

general_skills.title: Countertop Numeric Order
general_skills.principle: When searching for an object, visit countertops in ascending numeric order (1,2,3...).
general_skills.when_to_apply: When target object is not immediately visible and countertops exist.

general_skills.title: No Actions After Pickup
general_skills.principle: After picking up the target object, perform no actions other than transformation and placement until goal is complete.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you have just picked up the task object and are holding it.

general_skills.title: Hold Object Before Appliance
general_skills.principle: Do not approach transformation appliances unless holding the object to be transformed.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When the task requires cleaning, heating, or cooling.

general_skills.title: Open Surfaces Priority
general_skills.principle: Search all open surfaces (countertops, tables) before opening any closed containers.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible and open surfaces remain.

general_skills.title: Direct Post-Transform Placement
general_skills.principle: After transforming an object, go directly to the destination and place it, avoiding any intermediate actions.
general_skills.when_to_apply: Immediately after cleaning, heating, or cooling an object.

general_skills.title: Ignore Non-Target Objects
general_skills.principle: Do not pick up or interact with objects that do not match the task's target name or type.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When scanning furniture and noticing multiple objects.

general_skills.title: Highest Countertop First
general_skills.principle: Start searching open surfaces at the highest-numbered countertop and go downward.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When beginning exploration for an object on countertops.

general_skills.title: Verify Object Name Matches
general_skills.principle: Only pick up and place objects whose exact name matches the task description.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you see an object that might be the goal.

general_skills.title: Skip Closed Containers After Open
general_skills.principle: If a container is closed and you already opened it earlier, do not open it again.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When revisiting a container you previously opened.

general_skills.title: Direct Path After Pickup
general_skills.principle: Once you pick up a needed object, go directly to the transformation site or destination without intermediate actions.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you are carrying an object that requires cleaning, heating, cooling, or placement.

general_skills.title: Start at Countertop One
general_skills.principle: Begin every task by navigating to the first numbered countertop (countertop 1) to survey available objects.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When starting a new task and no object location is known.

general_skills.title: Avoid Non-Target Examination
general_skills.principle: Do not examine any object that is not the target or a required tool; focus on picking and placing.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When holding an object or after taking action, avoid unnecessary examine commands.

general_skills.title: Start at Countertop Two
general_skills.principle: Begin search at countertop 2, then move to countertop 1 before other furniture.
general_skills.when_to_apply: At the start of a task when multiple countertops are present.

general_skills.title: Take Visible Target First
general_skills.principle: If you see the goal object on an open surface, pick it up immediately without delay.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When the target object is visible and you are on its surface.

general_skills.title: Direct Path After Pickup
general_skills.principle: After picking up an object, go directly to the transformation or destination without intermediate stops.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When holding an object that needs to be transformed or placed.

general_skills.title: Skip Non-Storage Furniture
general_skills.principle: Avoid examining shelves, towel holders, or decorative items until all countertops, cabinets, and drawers are searched.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible and you have not exhausted storage furniture.

general_skills.title: After Placement Continue Search
general_skills.principle: After placing one of multiple objects, search new surfaces and containers for the remaining objects instead of returning to the previous location.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you have placed one object in a task that requires multiple placements.

general_skills.title: Avoid Immediate Re-pickup
general_skills.principle: Once an object is placed at its valid destination, do not pick it up again; proceed to the next required action.
general_skills.when_to_apply: After successfully placing an object at the intended location.

general_skills.title: Skip Containers if Target Visible
general_skills.principle: If the target object is visible on an open surface, do not open any containers; grab it immediately.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you spot the task object on a countertop or other open surface.

general_skills.title: Skip Empty Containers
general_skills.principle: If you open a container and it is empty, close it and move on without re-examining.
general_skills.when_to_apply: After opening a container that contains nothing.

general_skills.title: Grab Immediately When Seen
general_skills.principle: If the goal object is visible on the current surface, take it without delay.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you arrive at a surface and the target item is listed in the observation.

general_skills.title: Direct Post-Transform Placement
general_skills.principle: After transforming the object (cleaning/cooling/heating), go straight to the destination container, open it if needed, then place it.
general_skills.when_to_apply: After using a transformation tool (sink, fridge, microwave) on the held object.

general_skills.title: Ordered Open Surface Search
general_skills.principle: Search open surfaces (countertops, tables, bathtub) in ascending numerical order before opening any containers.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When the target object is not yet found and open surfaces remain.

general_skills.title: Start at Countertop Two
general_skills.principle: Begin each task by moving to countertop 2 if it exists; otherwise go to countertop 1.
general_skills.when_to_apply: At the very start of a task before any other actions.

general_skills.title: Skip Initial Look
general_skills.principle: At the start, do not use the look action; immediately navigate to a common surface like countertop1.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When beginning a task and the room description is provided.

general_skills.title: Skip Initial Look
general_skills.principle: Start by moving to a countertop rather than using the look command to begin object search immediately.
general_skills.when_to_apply: At the start of any task when the environment is first entered.

general_skills.title: Post-Placement New Surface Scan
general_skills.principle: After placing one of multiple objects, if the source is empty, search a different open surface.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you need multiple identical objects and the first source has none left.

general_skills.title: Task-Appropriate Furniture Start
general_skills.principle: Begin search at the furniture most likely to contain the target (e.g., desk for stationery, countertop for kitchen).
general_skills.when_to_apply: At the start of a new task.

general_skills.title: Avoid Endless Container Loops
general_skills.principle: After opening several containers with no target, switch to searching open surfaces.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you have opened multiple containers without finding the target.

general_skills.title: Place Only in Task Destination
general_skills.principle: Do not place a cleaned object in any location other than the one specified in the task.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you have a clean object and are deciding where to put it.

general_skills.title: Check Destination Type Before Search
general_skills.principle: Identify destination furniture type and prioritize searching surfaces near or similar to that type.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When the task involves placing an object and destination type is known.

general_skills.title: Avoid Premature Container Opening
general_skills.principle: Do not open any container until all open surfaces in the room have been visited.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When target object is not yet found and open surfaces remain unchecked.

general_skills.title: Return to Start After Failed Search
general_skills.principle: After exhausting all furniture without finding the target, return to starting location and rescan.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When all furniture has been searched and target is not found.

general_skills.title: Open Storage Before Placing
general_skills.principle: Before placing an object into a closed container (drawer, cabinet), open it first.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When about to place an object into a closed storage.

general_skills.title: Break Perpetual Loops
general_skills.principle: If you repeat the same sequence of actions, go to a new location you have not visited recently.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you have taken the same action multiple times without progress.

general_skills.title: Exhaust All Open Surfaces
general_skills.principle: Visit every open surface in the room before opening any closed container.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When the task goal is unknown or you need to find an object.

general_skills.title: Transform Immediately After Pickup
general_skills.principle: After picking up a target object, go directly to the transformation station without delay.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you have picked up an object that requires cleaning, heating, or cooling.

general_skills.title: Direct Sequence Completion
general_skills.principle: After picking up the object, go directly to the transformation station, then directly to the destination.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When holding an object that needs cleaning, heating, or cooling.

general_skills.title: Resume Surface Search
general_skills.principle: After opening a container and not finding the target, return to checking open surfaces before opening more containers.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When a container is opened and the target is not inside.

general_skills.title: Use Correct Transformation Verb
general_skills.principle: At a transformation appliance like sink or stove, use the specific action verb (clean, heat, cool) rather than 'move'.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When holding an object at the correct transformation location.

general_skills.title: Take Target From Open Container
general_skills.principle: If the target object is visible inside an open container, take it immediately without leaving.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When a container is open and contains the target object.

general_skills.title: Avoid Temporary Placement Loops
general_skills.principle: Do not place a held object on a surface and then immediately pick it up again; proceed directly.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you are holding the target object and are at a surface or sink.

general_skills.title: Transform Before Destination
general_skills.principle: After acquiring a task object that requires transformation, go directly to the transformation appliance before moving toward the destination.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When the task involves cleaning, heating, or cooling an object before placement.

general_skills.title: Start with Look
general_skills.principle: Begin each task by using the look action to observe all available furniture and objects in the room.
general_skills.when_to_apply: At the start of any new task or after moving to a new room.

general_skills.title: Pre-Transformation Inventory Check
general_skills.principle: Before moving to a transformation site (sink, microwave, stove), verify you are holding the target object. If not, continue searching surfaces.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you have not yet acquired the target object but are considering moving to a transformation location.

general_skills.title: Skip Non-Storage Furniture
general_skills.principle: During object search, only visit open surfaces (countertops, dining tables, shelves) and containers (cabinets, drawers). Ignore stoves, bathtubs, sinks unless task requires transformation.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When searching for an object and encountering non-storage furniture.

general_skills.title: Complete Task in Three Moves
general_skills.principle: Once you pick up the target object, go directly to the transformation station, then directly to the destination.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When holding the object needed for a manipulation task.

general_skills.title: Search Descending Order
general_skills.principle: If target not on countertops, check dining tables, then fridge, then cabinets, then drawers in that order.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When the target object is not immediately visible on the first surface.

general_skills.title: Open Surface Priority
general_skills.principle: Always search all open surfaces (countertops, dining tables) before opening any closed container.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When the target object is not immediately visible and containers exist.

general_skills.title: Avoid Empty-Handed Transformation
general_skills.principle: Do not go to the sink, microwave, or fridge unless you are holding the object that needs transformation.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When the next intended action is to clean, heat, or cool an object.

general_skills.title: Direct Sequence After Pickup
general_skills.principle: After picking up the target object, complete the transformation and placement in immediate succession without detours.
general_skills.when_to_apply: Immediately after acquiring the target object for a manipulation task.

general_skills.title: Immediate Transformation at Appliance
general_skills.principle: When holding a transformable object at the correct appliance, apply the transformation action immediately without any intervening actions.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you have the target object and are at the transformation appliance.

general_skills.title: Take Target From Open Container
general_skills.principle: When you open a container and see the target object inside, take it immediately without delay.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you open a container and the target object is visible inside.

general_skills.title: Grab Visible Target on Sight
general_skills.principle: If the target object is visible on the current surface, take it immediately. Do not navigate to another furniture piece first.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you arrive at a surface and see the target object.

general_skills.title: Pick Only Exact Name Match
general_skills.principle: Only pick up objects whose name exactly matches the task description. If you pick the wrong one, put it back immediately.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you are about to take an object that may not be the task target.

general_skills.title: After Placement Avoid Look
general_skills.principle: After placing an object, do not use 'look' or 'examine'. Proceed directly to the next required action.
general_skills.when_to_apply: Immediately after a successful move action.

general_skills.title: No Inventory After Placement
general_skills.principle: After placing the target object in its destination, do not check inventory or take any further actions; the task is complete.
general_skills.when_to_apply: Immediately after you have placed the object in the correct receptacle.

general_skills.title: One Look Per Location
general_skills.principle: When you arrive at a new location, use 'look' exactly once to see its contents; do not repeat it.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you enter a new furniture or area.

general_skills.title: Pick Exact Target Only
general_skills.principle: Only pick up objects that exactly match the target name in the task; ignore all other objects.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you see an object that might be the target.

general_skills.title: Direct Sequence After Pickup
general_skills.principle: After picking up the target, go directly to the transformation site and then to the destination without detours.
general_skills.when_to_apply: When you have the target object in hand.

pick_and_place.title: Systematic First-Pass Search
pick_and_place.principle: Maintain a checklist of all visible and closed containers/surfaces; open or inspect each unseen candidate exactly once before revisiting any location.
pick_and_place.when_to_apply: After reading the goal and before acquiring every required object.

pick_and_place.title: Grab When Seen
pick_and_place.principle: Whenever a needed object is visible and reachable, immediately take it before moving elsewhere—do not leave targets uncollected.
pick_and_place.when_to_apply: Upon first sight of an unheld object that matches the goal specification.

pick_and_place.title: Transform Before Transport
pick_and_place.principle: If the goal specifies a state change (e.g., heated, cooled, cleaned), perform the transformation at the nearest appropriate appliance before heading to the final destination.
pick_and_place.when_to_apply: Right after acquiring an object that must change state.

pick_and_place.title: Place Before More Search
pick_and_place.principle: When holding any goal object and the target location is known and reachable, navigate there and place it immediately, then resume searching if more items are needed.
pick_and_place.when_to_apply: While carrying a required object and the destination has been identified.

pick_and_place.title: Track Counts for Multiples
pick_and_place.principle: Maintain a tally of how many target objects are required, held, and already placed; stop searching only after the placed count meets the goal.
pick_and_place.when_to_apply: Throughout tasks demanding two or more instances of the same object.

pick_and_place.title: For Drinks, Check Fridge Early
pick_and_place.principle: When the target is a drink container (winebottle, glassbottle), search the fridge before other containers.
pick_and_place.when_to_apply: When the goal object is a drink-related item and not on open surfaces.

pick_two_obj_and_place.title: Two Objects Means Two Placements
pick_two_obj_and_place.principle: The goal requires two identical objects; placing the first one does NOT complete the task. After each placement, immediately resume searching for the next required object until two are placed.
pick_two_obj_and_place.when_to_apply: Whenever the goal contains "two"; especially right after putting the first object into the receptacle.

pick_two_obj_and_place.title: Remember the Second Location During First Search
pick_two_obj_and_place.principle: While searching for the first object, note any duplicate of the target seen elsewhere. After placing the first, go straight to that remembered location instead of re-searching the whole room.
pick_two_obj_and_place.when_to_apply: During the initial search phase of a two-object task, when a second matching object is spotted.

pick_two_obj_and_place.title: Carry-Place-Return Loop
pick_two_obj_and_place.principle: Carry one object at a time: pick up object A, take it to the receptacle, put it, then return to fetch object B and put it. Do not declare success until both objects are confirmed in the receptacle.
pick_two_obj_and_place.when_to_apply: For pick_two tasks where only one object can be held at a time.

pick_two_obj_and_place.title: Multi-Object: Return to Open Surfaces
pick_two_obj_and_place.principle: After placing one object for a multi-object task, immediately restart the search on all open surfaces.
pick_two_obj_and_place.when_to_apply: When the task requires placing more than one object and the first has been placed.

pick_two_obj_and_place.title: Return to Previous Found Location
pick_two_obj_and_place.principle: After placing the first object, return to the exact location where it was found to search for the second.
pick_two_obj_and_place.when_to_apply: When task requires placing two identical objects and first is placed.

pick_two_obj_and_place.title: Return After Single Placement
pick_two_obj_and_place.principle: After placing one object in a multi-object task, immediately return to the area where you found it to search for the next.
pick_two_obj_and_place.when_to_apply: When the task requires placing more than one object of the same type.

pick_two_obj_and_place.title: Return to Source After First Placement
pick_two_obj_and_place.principle: After placing the first object, immediately return to the location where it was found to search for the second.
pick_two_obj_and_place.when_to_apply: When the task requires placing two objects and the first has just been placed.

pick_two_obj_and_place.title: Return to Source for Second
pick_two_obj_and_place.principle: After placing the first of two identical objects, return to the exact location where you found it to search for the second.
pick_two_obj_and_place.when_to_apply: When one of two required objects has been placed.

look_at_obj_in_light.title: Seek Lamp Surfaces First
look_at_obj_in_light.principle: Head straight to furniture that commonly hosts a desklamp (desk, sidetable, nightstand) because the target must end up under that light.
look_at_obj_in_light.when_to_apply: Right after parsing a look-at-object-under-desklamp goal.

look_at_obj_in_light.title: Switch Lamp On
look_at_obj_in_light.principle: Issue 'use desklamp' as soon as you reach it so the light condition is satisfied before or immediately after handling the target object.
look_at_obj_in_light.when_to_apply: Upon arriving at a desklamp that is currently off.

look_at_obj_in_light.title: Acquire Or Fetch Target
look_at_obj_in_light.principle: If the target is on the lit surface, 'take' it; if found elsewhere, pick it up and carry it back to the lit lamp area.
look_at_obj_in_light.when_to_apply: Whenever the target object becomes visible, whether under the lamp or not.

look_at_obj_in_light.title: Systematic Surface Search
look_at_obj_in_light.principle: On each candidate lamp surface, look, open nearby containers/drawers once, then move on—ensuring all plausible lamp locations are covered.
look_at_obj_in_light.when_to_apply: After the lamp at the current surface is on and the target hasn’t been found.

look_at_obj_in_light.title: Prevent Action Loops
look_at_obj_in_light.principle: Avoid toggling the same lamp or re-examining the same empty spot; if no progress after one full check, relocate to a new plausible lamp location.
look_at_obj_in_light.when_to_apply: When repeated identical actions yield no new observations or objects.

look_at_obj_in_light.title: Stay at Light Source
look_at_obj_in_light.principle: After switching on a lamp, examine the surface directly under it before moving to other areas.
look_at_obj_in_light.when_to_apply: After turning on a light source in a look_at_obj_in_light task.

look_at_obj_in_light.title: After Light Activation, Check Nearby
look_at_obj_in_light.principle: After turning on a lamp, examine the surface where the lamp is located, as the target is often nearby.
look_at_obj_in_light.when_to_apply: When the task is to look at an object under a lamp.

look_at_obj_in_light.title: Stay and Examine After Light
look_at_obj_in_light.principle: After turning on a lamp, thoroughly examine the same surface and nearby surfaces before moving to distant locations.
look_at_obj_in_light.when_to_apply: When you have just activated a lamp in a look_at_obj_in_light task.

clean.title: Phase-Ordered Plan
clean.principle: Always execute clean tasks in the fixed sequence: 1) locate & acquire target object, 2) bring it to an available water source/sink to clean, 3) navigate to final location, 4) place object.
clean.when_to_apply: As soon as the goal specifies the object must be clean before placement.

clean.title: Pick Before You Wander
clean.principle: If the target object is visible or discovered, take it immediately; never leave it behind to explore other places, as possession enables direct cleaning and prevents redundant searches.
clean.when_to_apply: After visually confirming the presence of the target object on any surface or inside an opened container.

clean.title: Sink First for Cleaning
clean.principle: Upon holding the target object, go straight to the nearest sink, basin, or faucet and issue the clean/use command before any placement attempts.
clean.when_to_apply: Once the target object is in hand and its required state is ‘clean’.

clean.title: Systematic Container Sweep
clean.principle: When the object isn’t found on open surfaces, iterate through all unopened or unexamined containers in the room before revisiting already-checked spots to avoid search loops.
clean.when_to_apply: After initial obvious surfaces are empty and the target object remains unfound.

clean.title: State Verification Before Drop
clean.principle: Always inspect or infer the object’s state after cleaning; if still not confirmed clean, re-clean before final placement to satisfy goal conditions.
clean.when_to_apply: Immediately after a cleaning action and before placing the object at its target location.

clean.title: Use Location Priors
clean.principle: Begin search at the most probable category-specific surfaces (e.g., kitchenware on countertop/stove, food on dining table) to minimize exploration steps and avoid aimless roaming.
clean.when_to_apply: At the very start of the task to choose the first search destination for the target object.

clean.title: Clean After Pickup
clean.principle: After picking up a dirty object, go directly to a sinkbasin and clean it.
clean.when_to_apply: When holding a dirty object that requires cleaning.

clean.title: Place After Clean
clean.principle: After cleaning an object, go directly to the target receptacle and move the object there.
clean.when_to_apply: After successfully cleaning an object.

clean.title: Fridge First for Food
clean.principle: When cleaning food items, begin search by going to the fridge before exploring other containers.
clean.when_to_apply: When the task involves cleaning a food item (egg, pan, etc.).

clean.title: Cabinets First for Clean
clean.principle: For cleaning tasks, always search cabinets first as they are the most common location for items like soapbars, plates, and bowls.
clean.when_to_apply: At the start of a clean task when the target object's location is unknown.

clean.title: Clean Then Place Directly
clean.principle: After cleaning the object, go directly to the destination without any intermediate actions.
clean.when_to_apply: When you have just cleaned the target object and need to place it.

clean.title: Drawer First for Clean
clean.principle: Start search by checking drawers then open surfaces before opening cabinets.
clean.when_to_apply: At the beginning of a clean task when the object location is unknown.

clean.title: Countertop Before Cabinets
clean.principle: If drawer search fails, examine all countertops and sinkbasins next before opening cabinets.
clean.when_to_apply: After checking drawers without finding the target object.

clean.title: Transform Then Transport
clean.principle: After picking up the object, go directly to the transformation appliance (e.g., sink) before moving to the destination.
clean.when_to_apply: When the task requires cleaning the object before placement.

clean.title: Clean Before Moving to Destination
clean.principle: Ensure the object is cleaned while at the sink before transporting it to the final destination.
clean.when_to_apply: When holding a dirty object and planning to place it after cleaning.

clean.title: Acquire Before Cleaning
clean.principle: Always pick up the target object before moving to the sink. Do not go to the sink without holding the object.
clean.when_to_apply: When you intend to clean an object and you are not yet holding it.

clean.title: Dining Table After Countertops
clean.principle: If target not on initial countertop, proceed to dining tables before opening containers.
clean.when_to_apply: When the target is not visible on the first countertop.

clean.title: Prefer Sinkbasin for Cleaning
clean.principle: When cleaning an object, use the sinkbasin rather than bathtubbasin or other basins.
clean.when_to_apply: When you need to clean an object and a sinkbasin is available.

clean.title: No Sink Without Object
clean.principle: Do not go to the sinkbasin unless you are already holding the object that needs cleaning.
clean.when_to_apply: When the task requires cleaning and you are not yet holding the target object.

clean.title: Open Destination Before Placing
clean.principle: If the destination container is closed, open it before placing the cleaned object inside.
clean.when_to_apply: When holding a cleaned object and the destination is a closed container.

clean.title: No Detour After Clean
clean.principle: After cleaning the object, proceed directly to the destination and place it without exploring other locations.
clean.when_to_apply: After cleaning an object and the destination is known.

clean.title: Clean Immediately After Pickup
clean.principle: After picking up the target object, go directly to the sinkbasin to clean it without delay.
clean.when_to_apply: After picking up an object that needs cleaning.

clean.title: Containers After Open Surfaces
clean.principle: Search all open surfaces (countertops, dining tables) before opening any closed container.
clean.when_to_apply: When the cleaning target is not immediately visible on arrival.

clean.title: Clean Then Direct Place
clean.principle: After cleaning the object at a sinkbasin, go straight to the destination and place it.
clean.when_to_apply: When holding a cleaned object and the destination is known.

clean.title: Clean Objects From Trash
clean.principle: If target not on open surfaces, check garbage cans—they may contain the object.
clean.when_to_apply: When the target is not on countertops, tables, or shelves.

clean.title: Direct Path After Clean
clean.principle: After cleaning the object, go straight to the destination and place it without detours.
clean.when_to_apply: Immediately after the clean action succeeds.

clean.title: Clean on Sink Only
clean.principle: Always use the sinkbasin to clean objects; no other surface or tool suffices.
clean.when_to_apply: When the task involves cleaning an object.

clean.title: Countertop Priority Scan
clean.principle: Search all countertops in order before moving to other furniture types.
clean.when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible on initial countertop.

clean.title: Hold Object Directly to Sink
clean.principle: After picking up the target object, go immediately to the sinkbasin without opening any containers.
clean.when_to_apply: When holding an object that needs cleaning.

clean.title: Avoid Initial Sink Visit
clean.principle: Do not go to the sink or transformation site before acquiring the object to clean.
clean.when_to_apply: When starting a cleaning task and the target is not yet held.

clean.title: Systematic Countertop Survey
clean.principle: Visit all countertops to find the target object before searching other furniture.
clean.when_to_apply: When the target object is not visible on the initial countertop.

clean.title: Immediate Destination Preparation
clean.principle: Open the destination container immediately upon arrival before placing the cleaned object.
clean.when_to_apply: When you have a cleaned object and are at the destination container.

clean.title: No Post-Cleaning Detours
clean.principle: After cleaning, go directly to the destination without any intermediate stops or actions.
clean.when_to_apply: When you have just cleaned an object and need to place it.

clean.title: Complete Clean Before New Search
clean.principle: After placing a cleaned object, do not begin searching for another until the current task is fully done.
clean.when_to_apply: When the cleaning task involves a single object and placement is confirmed.

clean.title: Sequential Countertop Search
clean.principle: Visit countertops in numerical order (1,2,3,...) before checking other surfaces.
clean.when_to_apply: When target object not visible and countertops remain unchecked.

clean.title: Return Cleaned Object to Source
clean.principle: If destination is a generic cabinet or drawer, place the cleaned object back into the same container it was taken from.
clean.when_to_apply: When task destination is a generic furniture type and object came from one.

clean.title: Avoid Fridge for Clean Tasks
clean.principle: Do not open or visit fridge or microwave when searching for an object to clean; they are not cleaning sources.
clean.when_to_apply: When the task type is clean and you need to find an object.

clean.title: Sink After Pickup
clean.principle: After picking up a dirty object, go directly to the sinkbasin for cleaning without intermediate actions.
clean.when_to_apply: When holding an object that requires cleaning.

clean.title: Hold Object Before Sink
clean.principle: Only go to the sink if you are already holding the object to be cleaned.
clean.when_to_apply: When the task requires cleaning an object.

clean.title: Clean Then Place Directly
clean.principle: After cleaning, go directly to the destination and place the object without any detours.
clean.when_to_apply: After cleaning an object.

clean.title: Start Countertop for Clean
clean.principle: When searching for an object to clean, first check all countertops and open surfaces.
clean.when_to_apply: At the beginning of a clean task.

clean.title: Dining Table Search After Countertop
clean.principle: If the target is not on countertops, systematically search all dining tables before opening containers.
clean.when_to_apply: When starting a clean task and the target is not visible on the initial countertop.

clean.title: Ordered Search for Cleaning
clean.principle: Scan all open surfaces first, then check fridge for food items, then open cabinets for other objects.
clean.when_to_apply: When searching for a cleanable object and open surfaces are exhausted.

clean.title: Direct Sink After Pickup
clean.principle: After picking up a dirty object, go directly to the sink without detouring.
clean.when_to_apply: When holding an object that needs cleaning.

clean.title: No Sink Without Object
clean.principle: Only go to the sink if you are holding the object that needs cleaning.
clean.when_to_apply: When you need to clean an object.

clean.title: Avoid Circular Placement
clean.principle: Do not place an object back onto its original surface if it still needs cleaning or placement.
clean.when_to_apply: When holding an object that requires cleaning or final placement.

clean.title: Skip Examine on Clean Target
clean.principle: Do not examine an object that must be cleaned; proceed directly to the sink.
clean.when_to_apply: When you have just picked up an object that needs cleaning.

clean.title: Search Stoveburners After Countertops
clean.principle: If the target is not on any countertop, check stoveburners next before searching cabinets.
clean.when_to_apply: When cleaning an object and countertops are exhausted.

clean.title: Return to Surfaces After Container Miss
clean.principle: If a container does not hold the target, resume scanning open surfaces before opening more containers.

common_mistakes.description: Agent repeatedly revisits the same already-searched locations or containers instead of exploring new ones.
common_mistakes.why_it_happens: The agent lacks an explicit memory or policy for tracking explored areas, so its search strategy degenerates into local loops.
common_mistakes.how_to_avoid: Maintain an exploration map that records which rooms/containers have been fully inspected and prioritize unvisited or unopened candidates until all reasonable options are exhausted.

common_mistakes.description: Agent decides a closed container is empty without opening it, causing missed discoveries of target objects.
common_mistakes.why_it_happens: Heuristic shortcuts or cost-sensitive policies misjudge the effort of opening containers versus the value of inspecting them.
common_mistakes.how_to_avoid: Always open and inspect every plausible closed container at least once before ruling it out, using a checklist of unopened containers in the current room.

common_mistakes.description: Agent ignores or walks away from target objects that are already visible and reachable.
common_mistakes.why_it_happens: Perception-action coupling is weak, so detected objects are not tightly linked to action plans that acquire them.
common_mistakes.how_to_avoid: Embed a perception buffer that immediately queues pick-up actions for visible goal objects and interrupts any ongoing exploratory loop.

common_mistakes.description: Agent keeps searching after acquiring enough items because it loses track of how many targets have been collected.
common_mistakes.why_it_happens: Internal counters for goal progress are missing or not updated reliably when objects are picked up or placed.
common_mistakes.how_to_avoid: Maintain explicit numerical goals and increment/decrement them on every successful pickup or placement, triggering transition to the next sub-goal when counts are satisfied.

common_mistakes.description: Agent fails to deliver a held target object to the known destination, instead continuing to wander.
common_mistakes.why_it_happens: Planning separates acquisition and delivery but lacks a mechanism to reprioritize delivery once an item is in hand.
common_mistakes.how_to_avoid: Adopt a hierarchical policy that, upon holding a goal object, immediately switches to a high-priority ‘deliver-to-goal’ subtask before resuming further search.

common_mistakes.description: Agent completes spatial placement while skipping required state changes (e.g., cleaning, heating).
common_mistakes.why_it_happens: The agent conflates object presence with goal satisfaction and omits checking or planning for property predicates like cleanliness or temperature.
common_mistakes.how_to_avoid: Integrate state precondition checks into the planner so that placement actions are only considered valid after verifying and, if necessary, executing the requisite state-changing operations.

common_mistakes.description: Agent repeatedly toggles or examines objects that yield no new information or progress.
common_mistakes.why_it_happens: Exploration heuristics do not penalize redundant actions, leading to low-utility action loops when uncertain.
common_mistakes.how_to_avoid: Implement novelty or information gain metrics that discourage repeating identical actions unless the environment state has changed since the last attempt.

common_mistakes.description: Agent mishandles spatial relations (e.g., ‘under’, ‘inside’, ‘behind’) by inspecting only obvious surfaces and ignoring less visible sub-locations.
common_mistakes.why_it_happens: Parsing of relational language is not coupled with a comprehensive enumeration of environment affordances that can realize those relations.
common_mistakes.how_to_avoid: During task parsing, generate explicit search targets for all sub-locations associated with the reference object (drawers, shelves, underside) and iterate through them systematically.

common_mistakes.description: Agent forgets which object it is holding, leading to unnecessary pickups, drops, or misplacements.
common_mistakes.why_it_happens: The internal state does not persistently encode the identity and status of the carried object across time steps.
common_mistakes.how_to_avoid: Maintain a dedicated ‘hand inventory’ structure updated after every pickup/drop, and consult it before issuing navigation or interaction commands.

common_mistakes.description: Agent executes inefficient action sequences by searching for each required object serially rather than batching placements or leveraging proximity.
common_mistakes.why_it_happens: Lack of multi-goal planning causes the agent to treat each instance independently, resulting in unnecessary travel and toggling.
common_mistakes.how_to_avoid: Use planning algorithms that group similar subtasks, allowing the agent to collect all required objects in one pass before performing consolidated delivery or transformation steps.

common_mistakes.description: Agent prematurely terminates or stalls without having observed any candidate objects that satisfy the goal.
common_mistakes.why_it_happens: Termination criteria rely on step limits or subjective confidence rather than verified goal completion signals.
common_mistakes.how_to_avoid: Only allow ‘done’ actions when explicit goal predicates are met; otherwise, continue targeted exploration of remaining unvisited rooms and containers.

# Clean Task Skill Tree

## Goal Identification
- Parse the task: "clean some [object] and put it in/on [destination]" or "put a clean [object] in/on [destination]".
- The [object] must be cleaned at a sinkbasin or bathtubbasin before placing at [destination].

## Critical Rules (must be followed without exception)
1. **Never stay at or interact with the cleaning source unless you are holding the target object or you are searching for it there.** If you arrive at the cleaning source during search, immediately check whether the target is present. If yes, pick it up and proceed to the Cleaning Phase (you are already at the source). If not, leave immediately and resume the search. Do not clean, place, or examine unrelated items while there.
2. **Once you are holding the target object, do not put it down, look, examine, inventory, or interact with any other object until after you have cleaned it and placed it at the destination. The only allowed actions while holding the target are: moving to the cleaning source, cleaning it, moving to the destination, and placing it.**
3. **Do not go to the destination receptacle until after cleaning.**
4. **Before picking any object, verify its name matches the target exactly.** If the name differs (e.g., "handtowel" vs "cloth"), do not pick it up.
5. **If you are not holding the target object, you must be searching. Do not clean or place anything until you are holding the correct object.**

## Navigation
### Verify Target Location Reachability
- Before issuing `go to [location]`, check the current observation (or use `look` if uncertain) to see if that location is listed as reachable. If not, do not attempt the move; instead, find an intermediate location that is reachable and proceed step by step.
- After a move, **confirm you arrived at the intended location** by checking that the observation text contains "You arrive at [location]" or explicitly names the location you intended. If the observation shows a different location, the move did not work — reassess your current location and try an alternative route or use `look` to rediscover the graph.

### Using the Observation for Navigation
- The `look` command gives a list of all receptacles in the current room (the full set you can move to). Always use it as a fresh map when you lose orientation.
- If a `go to` action produces an unexpected arrival location, treat it as a navigation error: stop the search sequence, use `look` to see your actual location, and plan a valid path to the intended target before continuing.

## Search Phase
### Goal: Find the target object
- You must visit **every** receptacle in the current room until the target is found. Never assume a receptacle is empty without checking.
- Maintain a mental checklist of all receptacles from the initial `look` output. Work through them systematically.

### Order of Search
1. **Open surfaces** first: countertops, diningtables, stoveburners, shelves, garbagecan, handtowelholder, towelholder, sinkbasin, bathtubbasin, carts, and any other receptacle that is not a closed container. Visit each one exactly once. At each, examine its contents. If the target is present (verify name), pick it up and exit to Cleaning Phase. If not, move immediately to the next open surface. Do not look, examine, or perform any other action between open surfaces.
   - **Cleaning sources (sinkbasin, bathtubbasin) are open surfaces and must be visited** – but follow Critical Rule 1.
2. **Closed containers** after all open surfaces: cabinets, drawers, fridge, microwave, oven, etc. (any receptacle that requires opening).
   - **For food targets** (e.g., lettuce, potato, tomato, apple, bread, egg): open fridge first, then cabinets, then drawers, then microwave, then oven, then other closed containers (e.g., coffeemachine if openable).
   - **For non-food targets**: open cabinets first (numerical order if numbered), then drawers, then fridge, then microwave, then oven, then other closed containers.
   - At each closed container: `open [container]`. Look inside. If the target is inside, take it and exit to Cleaning Phase. If not, close the container (if possible) and **immediately** go to the next container in the prescribed order. Do not perform any other action between containers. Do not skip any container.

### Exhaustive Search Rule
- If you have checked all open surfaces and all closed containers and still have not found the target, **repeat the entire search cycle** (open surfaces again, then closed containers). This is rare but possible. Never stop searching until the target is found.

## Cleaning Phase
### Prerequisite: You must be holding the target object
- If empty-handed, return to Search Phase. If holding a different object, put it down first then return to Search Phase.

### Go to Cleaning Source
- Once holding the target, immediately go to the cleaning source (sinkbasin or bathtubbasin). Use Navigation rules to ensure you reach it correctly. If you are already there (from search), proceed directly to cleaning.
- **Do not perform any other action (look, examine, inventory, or move elsewhere) while en route or after arriving. Only clean.**

### Clean Immediately
- **Upon arrival at the cleaning source, the only valid next action is `clean [object] with [cleaning_source]`.** Do NOT look, examine, inventory, or move anywhere else. If you ever arrive at the cleaning source and are not immediately cleaning, you have made a mistake. Correct it by performing the clean action now.
- Confirm the observation says "You clean the [object] using the [cleaning_source]." Only then proceed to Placement Phase.

## Placement Phase
- Go to the destination receptacle (use Navigation rules). If it is a closed container, open it first.
- Use `move [object] to [destination]`.
- Confirm the object is now at the destination (observation will indicate placement).

## Completion
- Stop as soon as you have placed the clean object. Do not continue.

# Goal: Cool an object and move it to a specified target location.

## Navigation
- Before moving, check that the intended destination is reachable from your current location. If you are not sure, use 'look' to see observable locations.
- After executing a 'go to' action, read the observation carefully. Verify that you arrived at the exact location you intended (e.g., "You arrive at countertop 2"). If the observation says a different location, you did not reach it — do not assume success. Instead, consider that the target may not be adjacent or you may have misidentified it. Use 'look' to reassess adjacent locations, then try a different route (e.g., go to a known adjacent location first).
- Keep track of which instances you have already visited (e.g., countertop 1, countertop 2) to avoid revisiting them accidentally.

## Phase 1: Find and take the target object

### Surface search (priority order, not strict)
- **Preferred search order**: Start by searching the surfaces that most often hold objects: first check all countertops (every instance you saw in the initial look), then all diningtables. After those are exhausted, check sidetables, shelves, sinkbasins, stoveburners, and the inside of the fridge.
- **Flexibility**: You do not need to enforce this order rigidly. If you pass by a sinkbasin while moving between countertops, you may check it. Always prioritize the high-yield surfaces (countertops, diningtables) early, but do not skip a surface entirely just because you are not following the exact sequence.
- Use the 'go to' action to move to each surface instance. After arriving, read the observation to see what is on that surface. Do not use 'look' or 'examine' — the arrival observation already shows all items.
- For the fridge: if target found inside, take it and go to Phase 2. If not, close the fridge before moving on.
- **Handling arrival at an unintended location**: If you arrive at a location that is not the next one you intended, treat that location as visited (search it if it is a surface type you have not yet searched), then move to the next logical surface in the priority order.

### Exhaustive container search
- Only begin container search after you have checked **every** surface type (countertops, diningtables, sidetables, shelves, sinkbasins, stoveburners, and the inside of the fridge) and the target was not found.
- **Open each cabinet one by one**: Move to the cabinet, then use 'open cabinet X'. After opening, read the observation to see what is inside. If target present, take it, then close the cabinet before moving on. If not, close the cabinet and move to the next unopened cabinet.
- **Then check each drawer** (same process: move, open, look inside, close).
- **Then check the microwave** (open, look inside).
- **Crucial**: After moving to a container, you **must** open it to see its contents. The arrival observation does not show what is inside a closed container. If you skip opening, you will miss the target.

### Object verification
- Before taking, read the exact name. After taking, verify again. If wrong, put it back on the exact surface you took it from and resume searching from that location.

## Phase 2: Cool the object using the fridge
- As soon as you are carrying the correct target object, go to a fridge, open it (if closed), and use 'cool <object> with fridge'.

## Phase 3: Move the cooled object to the target location
- Go directly to the target location (e.g., cabinet, diningtable, garbagecan). If it is a closed container, open it first.
- Use 'move <object> to <target>'.

## Completion check
